relation_to_parallel_ingest.nonduplicate_delta: The predecessor establishes the documented Agent tool_response.agentId bridge and corrects packet provenance. This delta asks whether the pinned donor actually captures those identity fields as typed state.

findings: zulassen(payload) extracts session_id, tool_name and tool_input but does not extract tool_use_id, agent_id or Agent tool_response.agentId.
zulassen correlates PreToolUse to PostToolUse by writing one active_turns.effect_id per session.
merken(payload) extracts session_id, tool_name, tool_input and tool_response but does not typed-extract tool_use_id, agent_id or tool_response.agentId.
merken stores a shortened/redacted representation of tool_response in durable_memory, which is opaque/lossy evidence rather than a typed child-execution identity binding.
For state-changing tools, merken resolves effect_id from active_turns by session_id, preserving the already-known same-session overlapping-call ambiguity.

external_primary_revalidation.source: Claude Code official hooks and sub-agents documentation observed 2026-08-28
findings: Agent is the current native subagent-spawn tool; Task was renamed to Agent in Claude Code v2.1.63 and remains an alias.
Agent PostToolUse documents tool_response.agentId for completed and async-launched Agent calls.
Subagent lifecycle hooks expose agent_id; task-system hooks expose separate task_id.

architecture_finding.consequence: Adding SubagentStart/SubagentStop hooks alone is insufficient. Frankenstein 2.0 needs a typed hook-ingest/reducer path that preserves call-scoped tool_use_id and child agent_id/agentId before WorkExecutionBinding can receive executable causal credit.

work_execution_binding_v1_refinement.normalization_rule: agentId and agent_id may be normalized into one child identity only when equality is directly observed on the installed/version-pinned runtime path or guaranteed by the exact admitted version contract; never by timing/order.
work_execution_binding_v1_refinement.task_id_rule: task_id remains optional and separate from child agent identity.
work_execution_binding_v1_refinement.opaque_memory_rule: A truncated/redacted tool_response string is not sufficient typed causal identity evidence.

contradictions_preserved: Current official docs expose an exact Agent response child identifier, but the pinned donor does not typed-capture the relevant field names.
The donor still names Task in GW tool vocabulary while current Claude Code names the spawn tool Agent; Task compatibility does not prove the donor sees current Agent events as intended.
A host-private/global hook path may capture these fields outside the donor repository; repository absence is not host-runtime absence.

Read and preserve tool_use_id on PreToolUse/PostToolUse and agentId/agent_id on Agent/lifecycle events without session-scoped overwrite.
